name: Alex Sample

daily_sub: Alex Sample - inner: natal chart / outer: today's sky

sun.head: Sun in Gemini (9th house)
lines: Curiosity points outward and upward: learning,
connecting and publishing keep you centred.

moon.head: Moon in Pisces (1st house)
lines: Feelings arrive first and quietly. You need soft
edges and time near water or music to reset.

asc.head: Ascendant (rising point): Scorpio
lines: The first impression is reserved and intense.
You open up slowly, and then completely.

summary: A connector of ideas with a private, feeling inner life.
The contrast between the open, quick surface and the
deep water underneath is the charm of this chart.

top.head: Jupiter trine Pluto (orb 0.42)
lines: Growth and depth pull in the same direction.
Big changes tend to land as upgrades.

top.head: Saturn sextile MeanLilith (orb 0.87)
lines: Discipline gives the wild part of you a frame
instead of a cage.

top.head: Neptune sextile Pluto (orb 1.68)
lines: A generational background hum: dreams and
transformation move together, slowly.

uranian.head: Sun/MC midpoint = Neptune (orb 0.24)
lines: Your public direction is coloured by imagination.
Work with images, sound or story fits the axis.

uranian.head: Sun/MC midpoint = Vulcanus (orb 1.36)
lines: When the direction is set, the output is
out of scale. Bursts, not drips.

points.head: Transit Mercury sextile natal Uranus (orb 0.01)
lines: A very tight, bright contact. News, tools and
short trips sparkle. Say yes to the new app.

points.head: Transit Sun conjunct natal Pluto (orb 0.10)
lines: Depth day. One honest conversation can move
something that was stuck for months.

deep: Transit Sun trine natal Vulcanus (orb 0.67): the deep-dive
point. A day when focused effort produces outsized
results - pick one target and push.
lucky: Try the tool you have been postponing / Write the idea down before noon
